# BLOG · changelogtriggers-subscriptions · 1nzg5wm

**Outcome.** infra class — reported, no MR

**Root cause.** changelogTriggers-subscriptions is generated by firestore-bigquery-changelog's registerV2 with no memory option, so it deploys at the firebase-functions v2 default of 256 MiB while loading this repo's src/index.js import graph needs 318 MiB — the container is OOM-killed during module load, never binds :8080, and the CreateFunction call fails.

**Mechanism.** packages/functions/src/config/changelog.js:8 calls changelog.registerV2({collections:[{shops},{shopInfos},{subscriptions}]}) with no memory field; packages/functions/src/globalOptions.js:5 sets only region and VPC, so no memory is declared anywhere in the chain and firebase-functions/v2 falls back to 256 MiB — confirmed by the deployed spec in the CreateInternalService audit log, resources.limits.memory="256Mi", container "worker", startupProbe tcpSocket:8080 timeoutSeconds:240 failureThreshold:1. packages/functions/src/index.js:12 exports changelogTriggers from the same index.js that re-exports http/pubsub/scheduled/firestore (koa, shopify, langchain/langgraph, ioredis, googleapis), so the container evaluates the full graph before the functions framework can listen. Instance 00a41e8c1d6dbcd4c191bf5f… logged 'Memory limit of 256 MiB exceeded with 318 MiB used' at 2026-08-18T08:25:26.219215Z and, 0.441 ms later on the same instanceId, 'Default STARTUP TCP probe failed 1 time consecutively for container "worker" on port 8080' at 08:25:26.219656Z — the alerted probe failure is the consequence of the OOM kill, not a platform startup stall. Cloud Run then flipped Ready=False with reason HealthCheckContainerError at 08:25:26.740835Z on revision changelogtriggers-subscriptions-00001-xer, and CreateFunction (principal tuannv@avadagroup.com) returned status code 3 'Container Healthcheck failed' at 08:25:31.213262190Z. Revision 00001 means this was the function's first-ever deploy, so it does not exist in prod and no `subscriptions` changelog rows reach BigQuery. Contrast: the hand-written Firestore triggers in packages/functions/src/functions/firestore.js all declare memory:'512MiB' and deployed fine in the same window.

Confidence: `high` · infra class, not auto-fixed

## Code
- `packages/functions/src/config/changelog.js:8` — registerV2({collections:[...]}) passes no memory/cpu option, so the three generated gen2 triggers take the firebase-functions v2 default of 256 MiB
- `packages/functions/src/config/changelog.js:12` — the `subscriptions` collection entry — the specific trigger in this alert
- `packages/functions/src/globalOptions.js:5` — setGlobalOptions declares only region and VPC — no global memory floor, so nothing rescues a function that declares none
- `packages/functions/src/index.js:12` — changelogTriggers is exported from the same index.js that re-exports http/pubsub/scheduled/firestore, so each changelogtriggers-* container loads the full 318 MiB import graph before binding :8080
- `packages/functions/src/functions/firestore.js:36` — onTokenUserWritten declares memory:'512MiB' and deployed successfully in the same run — the tier the changelog triggers should match
